title: Doutorado em Computação (Edital PPGC 004/2026)
institution: Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), Programa de Pós-Graduação em Computação (PPGC)
about: UFRGS's Graduate Program in Computing (PPGC) runs a continuous-flow selection for its doctorate: applications are received from August 2026 to 10 February 2027, for entry between September 2026 and May 2027.
requirements: Continuous-flow selection: documents received between 01/08/2026 and 10/02/2027
